title: First-class virtual groups for independent atomic rules
abstract: The ontology should support first-class virtual group entities with stable IDs, metadata labels, identity colors, display cards and named membership relations to independently existing rules. Selecting a group should explicitly add all eligible member rules in one action without forcing the group to be applied by default, duplicating rule content, or requiring all member rules to be chosen individually. Group membership may overlap, and nested collection expansion must deduplicate by canonical rule identity.

source.reference: Public-safe statement of the proposed virtual group mechanism

scope_hints.rule_identity_requirement: Every member remains independently addressable, applicable, versionable and selectable.
scope_hints.color_algorithm: Nomos existing ID-keyed OKLCH identity mechanism

unresolved: A first-class group kind would require explicit ontology/schema/governance changes after specimen processing; queued definitions are not active catalog objects.
Resolve specimen references to approved catalog rule IDs after rule normalization, without silently promoting draft or rejected proposals.
Define membership inheritance and group nesting cycles; ensure one-click composition deduplicates members.
Allow a rule in multiple groups and preserve group changes independently of rule versions.
Group selection must never override conditional applicability, authority or conflicts.
remarks: Intake only; none of the groups or 54 atomic specimens has been processed, published or activated.
